units.source_text: 沙子夜间吸进的湿气，蒸发后吐回大气中……

en.t: The moisture the sand had absorbed during the night evaporated and was breathed back into the air...

units.source_text: 光的折射，散发出湿漉漉的柏油似的光……

en.t: The refraction of the light gave off a wet, asphalt-like gleam...

units.source_text: 但是，它简直比砂锅里炒麦粉还要干燥，

en.t: And yet it was even drier than wheat flour roasted in an earthen pot,

units.source_text: 本质不过是没有掺杂物的1/8mm。

en.t: its essence nothing more than an unadulterated one eighth of a millimeter.
